name: IN ALL ITS GLORY
source:
A visual novel about a medieval monk who just wants to keep his head down and pray. Unfortunately for Brother Hermann, he's being blackmailed by an angel who disapproves of his friendship with an inquisitor. 

[From [url=https://kittium.itch.io/in-all-its-glory]itch.io[/url]]

A visual novel about a medieval monk who just wants to keep his head down and pray. Unfortunately for Brother Hermann, he's being blackmailed by an angel who disapproves of his friendship with an inquisitor.
